title: Paragon
blurb: You run a hero corps over a comic-book city at night, and the heroes earn Justice on their own. Reboot the timeline for Legacy, rewrite the multiverse for Continuity, then turn the Age for Canon: each layer wipes the one below it and hands it to automation. Between resets, Elseworlds run the corps under worse rules for permanent rewards.
